data.summary:
This model follows these rules:

- It must be placed in Reserves at the start of the battle, and neither it nor any unit embarked in it counts toward any limit on how many Reserves units you may start with.
- It can arrive during the Reinforcements step of any of your first 3 Movement phases, whatever the mission rules say.
- Once it is on the battlefield, units embarked in it may disembark, and any that do must be set up over 9" from every enemy model.
